items.titleEn: Stream U19s against Bayern Munich on Wednesday
items.summaryEn: Our UEFA Youth League campaign continues with a trip to Germany to face Bayern Munich
bodyEn: Our under-19s continue their UEFA Youth League campaign with a trip to southern Germany to take on Bayern Munich on Wednesday afternoon (3pm UK), and you can stream the action live on The Arsenal app and on Arsenal.com.
David Horseman's side have taken three points from their opening two Youth League matches, beating Napoli 2-1 in Italy before losing 3-2 in a thrilling contest with LOSC Lille.
We enter Matchday 3 in 18th-place, just inside the knockout stage places, which stretch down to 22nd; Bayern sit three places above us on goal difference with four matches to play.
Make sure to tune in to live coverage of the fixture on The Arsenal app and on Arsenal.com from 2.55pm (UK) to watch the 3pm kick-off live from Bavaria.

items.titleEn: Four Premier League games in December rearranged
items.summaryEn: Our Premier League games against Brentford, Tottenham, Bournemouth and Manchester United have all been selected for live TV coverage
bodyEn: Four of our Premier League games in December have been moved for live TV coverage in the UK.
We begin the month with a trip to Brentford, and that game will remain on Wednesday, December 2 but will now kick off at 8.15pm.

The following weekend, we’re back on the road in the capital to tackle Tottenham Hotspur in the first north London derby of the campaign. It will take place at our rivals' home on Sunday, December 6, with a 4.30pm start.

The next week, we’re back in league action at Emirates Stadium against Bournemouth, and that game will also be on a Sunday on December 13 due to the Cherries' involvement in the Europa League. The game will kick off at 2pm.
Our final Premier League game before Christmas is a blockbuster clash against Manchester United at Emirates Stadium, and that too has been shifted to Sunday, December 20, at 4.30pm.
As previously communicated, our festive matches will be at Crystal Palace on Sunday, December 27, and a trip to Craven Cottage to face Fulham on Wednesday, December 30.
All our Premier League games up until the end of 2026 have now been scheduled for TV, however fixtures are still subject to change for other reasons.

items.titleEn: Konsa bullish about Arsenal’s Champions League hopes as Bayern clash looms

bodyEn: For Ezri Konsa, it was just a wonderfully satisfying challenge. The Nottingham Forest striker Liam Delap had stolen in behind him up the inside left channel on Sunday. There were 93 minutes gone, Arsenal were 1-0 up and it was now or never for Forest. Konsa decreed that it would be never, curving his covering run back, matching Delap for pace and stretching into the perfect block tackle.

So, another win for Arsenal: their 10th in 11 matches this season. Another clean sheet. And for Konsa, a continuation of what has been a dreamlike couple of months. Do points-saving last-minute challenges mean more when the defender is actually a fan of the club, too? Basically, yes.

“I’ve been asked this a lot,” Konsa says with a smile, when the subject of his boyhood allegiance is raised. “And, yes, I was [an Arsenal supporter]. I had a lot of Arsenal kits when I was younger. You dream of playing for big clubs like this. When you’re a kid, you see the likes of Arsenal, growing up, and the amount of quality players they’ve had throughout the years and to be here – and not only to be here but to be here with close friends – makes it even more special.”

Konsa is talking about Eberechi Eze, in particular; another boyhood Arsenal fan, with whom he is especially tight. Many supporters have seen the clip of Eze greeting Konsa at the training ground after the latter had completed his £51m move from Aston Villa and how they crack up with laughter before embracing. It is infectious. But Konsa knows a clutch of other Arsenal players from England duty – Declan Rice, Bukayo Saka, Noni Madueke, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Ben White – and he credits them with helping him to settle in.

The 28-year-old’s adaptation has been quick and it has needed to be with William Saliba injured. After making his Arsenal debut as a substitute at Villa – Konsa’s scriptwriters have been hard at work – he has played in every minute of the club’s Premier League and Champions League matches. The victory at Forest, where Arsenal had drawn 0-0 in each of the previous two seasons, was significant. It was not a performance of any attacking pace or spark. Perhaps it made the points feel more precious.

“We hadn’t won here in two seasons, the boss was going on about it,” Konsa says. “It’s something we wanted to change as players and these are the games you have to win. If you want to win titles, you have to come away to tough places like this and get three points.”

Things are about to get even more interesting for Konsa and Arsenal because on Wednesday they face Bayern Munich at the Allianz Arena in the Champions League. “It’s against my international teammate as well,” Konsa says, and he is straight into an appreciation of Harry Kane, the England captain, who has been on fire since joining Bayern from Tottenham in 2023. Kane’s scoring record for the club bears repeating: 155 goals in 157 appearances.

Konsa has a good record against Kane, having faced him seven times, six of them for Villa against Spurs. The seventh and most recent came in October 2024 when Konsa was in the Villa team that beat Kane’s Bayern 1-0 at Villa Park in the Champions League. It was Villa’s first home match in the competition for 41 years. The defender has four wins against Kane’s teams and three losses. Kane has only scored twice against him, both from penalties.

“The Villa-Bayern game … to beat them at home and keep a clean sheet … it was very special for the players and the fans,” Konsa says. “I don’t really look much at those kind of stats [against individual players] but I am relishing the challenge.”

The dynamics against Bayern appear different for Konsa this time. It was a famous victory for Villa that night, in part because of the tie’s history; the club beat Bayern 1-0 in the 1982 European Cup final. Villa were underdogs as they felt their way back into Europe’s elite competition. Arsenal will kick off as Bayern’s equals and among the favourites to win the tournament, having lost on penalties to Paris Saint-Germain in last season’s final.

Konsa won the first trophy of his career a week before that when he was in the Villa team that defeated Freiburg in the Europa League final. He says he has felt the determination of the Arsenal squad to go one step further in Europe.

“One hundred per cent,” Konsa says. “As players, the standards we have, the goals we have … we want to win everything – the Champions League, the Prem. Whatever trophies are in front of us. When I came to Arsenal, I wanted to win. I was hungry to win. Last season I got my hands on the Europa League and this season I want more.”

items.titleZh: 孔萨对阿森纳欧冠前景充满信心，即将迎战拜仁
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳中卫孔萨迅速融入球队，渴望赢得欧冠与英超等一切冠军，并将迎来与哈里·凯恩的较量。
bodyZh: 对埃兹里·孔萨来说，这只是一次令人无比满足的防守挑战。周日比赛进行到第93分钟时，诺丁汉森林前锋利亚姆·德拉普从小禁区左侧插上，当时阿森纳以1-0领先，这是森林队最后的扳平机会。孔萨没有给对手机会，他全速回追，在速度上跟住了德拉普，并完成了一次完美的放铲封堵。
因此，阿森纳又取得了一场胜利：这是他们本赛季11场比赛中的第10场胜利，也是又一场零封。对孔萨来说，这延续了他过去几个月如梦幻般的生活。当这位后卫本身就是俱乐部的球迷时，这种在比赛最后时刻化解危机、捍卫积分的防守是否更具意义？答案是肯定的。
当被问及儿时支持的球队时，孔萨笑着说道：“这个问题我被问过很多次。是的，我曾经是[阿森纳球迷]。我小时候有很多件阿森纳球衣。你总是梦想着为这样的大俱乐部效力。当你还是个孩子的时候，看着像阿森纳这样的球队以及他们多年来拥有的大批优秀球员，如今能身处这里——不仅能来到这里，还能和好朋友们并肩作战——这一切让这一切变得更加特别。”
孔萨这里特指埃贝雷奇·埃泽，他也是从小支持阿森纳的球迷，两人关系格外要好。许多球迷都看过一段视频：在孔萨以5100万英镑从阿斯顿维拉转会加盟后，埃泽在训练基地迎接他，两人开怀大笑并拥抱在一起，这种氛围极具感染力。不过，孔萨也通过英格兰队结识了阿森纳的其他几名球员——德克兰·赖斯、布卡约·萨卡、诺尼·马杜埃凯、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、本·怀特——他非常感谢这些队友帮助他迅速融入球队。
这位28岁球员的适应过程非常快，在威廉·萨利巴受伤的情况下，这也实属必要。在维拉替补登场完成阿森纳首秀之后——孔萨的剧本似乎早已写好——他踢满了球队在英超和欧冠中的每一分钟。客场战胜森林的比赛意义重大，过去两个赛季阿森纳在这里都以0-0战平。这场比赛并没有展现出太多的进攻速度或火花，或许这也让这三分显得更加珍贵。
孔萨表示：“我们已经有两个赛季没在这里赢过球了，主教练一直在强调这一点。作为球员，这是我们想要改变的事情，这些就是你必须取胜的比赛。如果你想赢得冠军，你就必须来到这样艰难的客场拿走三分。”
接下来，孔萨和阿森纳将迎来更具挑战的赛程，因为周三他们将在欧冠联赛中前往安联球场客场挑战拜仁慕尼黑。孔萨说：“这也是对阵我的国家队队友。”他直接表达了对英格兰队长哈里·凯恩的赞赏，后者自2023年从热刺转会拜仁以来状态火热。凯恩在这家俱乐部的进球纪录值得重温：157场比赛攻入155球。
孔萨对阵凯恩的战绩不错，两人此前交手过七次，其中六次是代表维拉对阵热刺。第七次也是最近的一次是在2024年10月，当时孔萨效力的维拉在维拉公园球场进行的欧冠比赛中以1-0击败了凯恩所在的拜仁。那是维拉41年来首次在该项赛事中踢主场比赛。这位后卫对阵凯恩的球队取得了四胜三负的战绩，而凯恩在他面前只攻入过两球，且全部来自点球。
孔萨表示：“维拉对阵拜仁的那场比赛……在主场击败他们并完成零封……对球员和球迷来说都非常特别。我其实并不太看重针对单个球员的那些数据统计，但我非常期待这项挑战。”

对孔萨而言，这一次对阵拜仁的氛围将有所不同。当晚维拉取得了一场名垂青史的胜利，部分原因在于这段历史渊源；该俱乐部在1982年欧洲冠军杯决赛中曾以1-0击败过拜仁。当时重返欧洲顶级赛事的维拉是以黑马姿态出战的。而阿森纳此番将作为拜仁的势均力敌之对手、并带着夺冠热门之一的身份开球，上赛季他们在决赛中点球不敌巴黎圣日耳曼。
就在那场决赛的一周前，孔萨随维拉在欧罗巴联赛决赛中击败弗赖堡，赢得了职业生涯的第一个冠军。他表示，自己已经感受到了阿森纳全队在欧洲赛场上更进一步的决心。
孔萨说道：“百分之百。作为球员，我们所拥有的标准、我们所确立的目标……我们想要赢得一切——欧冠、英超。只要是摆在我们面前的奖杯。当我来到阿森纳时，我就渴望胜利，我有着强烈的求胜欲。上赛季我捧起了欧罗巴联赛冠军，而本赛季我想要更多。”

items.titleEn: Konsa: "I had a lot of Arsenal kits"
items.summaryEn: Ezri on his scintillating start to life in N5
bodyEn: Ezri Konsa has adjusted to life at Arsenal seamlessly.

The defender has already racked up five clean sheets while featuring for the Gunners since his summer switch from Aston Villa - the latest coming in Sunday’s determined 1-0 victory at Nottingham Forest.
Konsa was called into emergency action in second-half stoppage time, chasing back to execute a perfectly timed challenge, preventing Forest’s Liam Delap charging through on goal.
After the win at the City Ground, he reflected on the result, the challenge and facing many of the world’s best.
“If you want to win titles, you have to come to tough places like these and get three points,” Ezri declared.
“As a centre-back, I look forward to playing against the best, and in the Premier League, every striker has their own qualities.

“Liam Delap for example is a very physical striker and gave me some moments. You have to recover sometimes to make that tackle, and sometimes if your position is better, then you don’t have to make it - but it’s nice when it comes off.”
Born and raised in Newham while coming through the Charlton Athletic academy, Konsa is one of millions of Londoners to sprout a lifelong connection with Arsenal.
He turns 29 this week - and having lifted the Europa League with Villa in Istanbul last season, this summer presented the chance of his dream move at a key stage of his career.

Ezri exudes experience and confidence in any backline, and his cohesive transition into Mikel Arteta’s defence comes as no surprise as he revealed how he has been welcomed back in his home city - including by several of his England teammates.
“Everyone saw Arsenal’s record last season defensively, keeping clean sheets, and it’s something I wanted to continue when I joined the club,” he explained.
“Huge credit goes to the boys and the staff from day one - I know a few from England, but everyone has made me feel welcome from the start and I’m really happy to be here.

“I was an Arsenal fan as a kid - I had a lot of Arsenal kits when I was younger and there have been a few posts. You dream of playing for a big club like this, and when you see the players they’ve had throughout the years, to become part of that is what it’s about.”
Wednesday brings another titanic test for which to prepare, with our third league phase fixture around the corner against Bayern Munich in the Champions League.
With a 100 percent record, we are yet to concede in this season's competition - but Konsa noted the monumental threat of Vincent Kompany’s attack, including his national teammate Harry Kane.
“He’s a striker who can drop deep, go into midfield, drag players around, assist and score. And it’s not just him, they have Luis Diaz out wide, they have great players all over the pitch.
“It’s likely to be quite an equal game, but we have to focus on ourselves and go for the win.
“We’re 100 percent looking to win everything - win the Champions League - with the players and standards we have.”

items.titleZh: 孔萨：我小时候有很多阿森纳球衣
items.summaryZh: 埃兹里·孔萨谈到了自己在阿森纳的闪光开局与儿时情结。
bodyZh: 埃兹里·孔萨无缝适应了在阿森纳的生活。
自从今夏从阿斯顿维拉转会以来，这位后卫在代表阿森纳出场期间已经完成了五场零封——最近一场是在周日客场1比0顽强战胜诺丁汉森林的比赛中。
在下半场补时阶段，孔萨临危受命，回追完成了一次时机恰当的铲断，阻止了森林队的利亚姆·德拉普形成单刀。
在城市球场取胜后，他回顾了比赛结果、那次防守挑战以及面对世界顶级前锋的感受。
埃兹里表示：“如果你想赢得冠军，你就必须来到这样艰难的球场全取三分。”
“作为一名中后卫，我非常期待与最优秀的球员交手，而在英超联赛中，每位前锋都有他们自己的特点。”
“以利亚姆·德拉普为例，他是一个身体对抗很强的前锋，给我制造了一些麻烦。有时你必须通过回追来完成铲断，如果你的站位更好，也许就不需要做这种动作了——但当它成功时感觉很棒。”
孔萨在纽汉出生长大，并在查尔顿竞技青训营成长，他是数百万与阿森纳有着终身联系的伦敦人之一。
他本周将迎来29岁生日。上赛季他随维拉在伊斯坦布尔捧起欧联杯冠军，而这个夏天在他职业生涯的关键阶段带来了实现梦想转会的机会。
埃兹里在任何后防线上都散发着经验与自信，他完美融入米克尔·阿尔特塔的防线并不令人意外。他透露了自己如何受到家乡的欢迎，其中包括几位英格兰队友。
他解释道：“每个人都看到了阿森纳上赛季的防守纪录和零封表现，这也是我加盟俱乐部后想要延续的事情。”
“从第一天起，功劳就属于小伙子们和教练组——我认识几个英格兰队的队友，但从一开始每个人都让我感到受欢迎，我真的很高兴能来到这里。”
“我从小就是阿森纳球迷——我小时候有很多阿森纳球衣，网上也有过一些相关的帖子。你总是梦想为这样一家大俱乐部效力，当你看到他们历年来拥有的球星时，能成为其中一员正是意义所在。”
周三我们将迎来另一场严峻考验，我们在欧冠联赛阶段的第三场比赛即将在主场对阵拜仁慕尼黑。
凭借百分之百的胜率，我们在本赛季的欧冠比赛中尚未失球——但孔萨指出了文森特·孔帕尼麾下进攻火力的巨大威胁，其中包括他的国家队队友哈里·凯恩。
“他是一位能够回撤、拉到中场、牵扯防守、助攻和进球的前锋。而且不仅是他，他们还有边路的路易斯·迪亚斯，全场到处都是伟大的球员。”
“这可能将是一场势均力敌的比赛，但我们必须专注于自己，全力争取胜利。”
“凭借我们拥有的球员和标准，我们百分之百渴望赢得一切——赢得欧冠冠军。”

bodyEn: When Bayern Munich fail to win for two games in a row, you know what is coming next. Particularly on a Saturday night showcase, against the sort of good domestic opposition that tend to bring the best out of the champions. It had been a frustrating week, domestically and continentally, in two games on the road. On both occasions they had been caught cold, conceding the Bundesliga’s fastest goal at Augsburg and going 1-0 down in less than 90 seconds in Stavanger.

Vincent Kompany’s low profile on the Allianz Arena touchline, almost motionless in his seat as his team rattled a flurry of goals past poor RB Leipzig, had nothing to do with any lingering chagrin connected to those slow starts from his team. The sporting director, Max Eberl, who stood in for his coach in the post-match press conference, explained that the Belgian had been ill, not to mention Kompany’s current hip problem that had made the move from dressing room to pitchside slow and uncomfortable.

It was good he did not attempt to get up from his vantage point every time his team scored, or he would have been extremely sore in the morning. This was what Kicker referred to as a “Trainingsspiel in der Allianz Arena”. Had it not been for the goalkeeper Maarten Vandevoordt performing creditably, Leipzig’s club-record defeat – a 7-0 loss to Manchester City three and a half years ago – would have been comfortably surpassed. This was carnage.

For Leipzig and their coach, the former Bayern man Martin Demichelis, this 6-1 defeat was the starkest of reality checks. The media reaction was the same, a sense of disappointment that a supposed competitor to Bayern could offer so little in terms of resistance. Yet there needed to be a recognition too that this was Bayern being their brilliant best; piqued, prickly and poked into action by a potential challenge that they felt compelled to prove wasn’t much of one.

This was a furious clearing of frustration on a number of levels; the need to defend Manuel Neuer after his early error at Augsburg, the industrial scale of chances frittered away in that game, the first-half punking by Viking in midweek, the concession of a late equaliser having come back and the red card for Michael Olise (Eberl had memorably called Viking’s captain, Zlatko Tripic, a “scumbag” for systematically winding up the France midfielder to the point at which he picked up two bookings in the blink of an eye, the second for gently lobbing the ball in Tripic’s face, forcing the latter to throw himself to the ground).

And how that feeling was expelled from the very beginning. Harry Kane called Vandevoordt into action in the opening seconds, but it was only a temporary let-off for the visitors. Luis Díaz steamed on to a Joshua Kimmich pass to fly through the centre of the Leipzig defence and give Bayern the lead in the 12th minute. The Colombian created a second with a delicious pass for the onrushing Aleksandar Pavlovic just before the half-hour, and just after a stunning collective move finished with Kane carving a chance for Olise to finish imperiously.

It was a recital. The move that led to the Pavlovic goal began with Kane steering the ball left from a quarterback position, maybe 10 to 15 metres in front of his own penalty area. In the second half Díaz fully took centre stage, gathering a Kane pass to chop inside and curl a shot into the far corner, then scurrying the long way around to finish from a central area and complete his hat-trick – not the perfect hat-trick perhaps, but maybe the perfect Luis Díaz hat-trick of centre, from the left and long run around to finish. His first Bundesliga goals since August were scoffed with the demeanour of a famished man.

This version of Díaz will be needed against Arsenal with Olise suspended, and the score settling version of Bayern will be the default too, with this the perfect warm up in that sense, even if Leipzig were more compliant than might have been expected. Nobody in Munich has forgotten their first defeat of last season, 11 months ago, when Arsenal stepped up a gear and showed just how good they had become in a comprehensive second-half display at the Emirates Stadium that led to a 3-1 win. “We have memories of that game,” said Eberl, “and we want to translate those memories into energy this Wednesday.”

There is a sense of this all just being shadow-boxing, of course, in a league stage that Bayern and Arsenal will be expected to graduate from safely in the top eight. Yet any measure of where they are and where they are headed is useful. Even if this was not a win or go home situation, Saturday’s game could be the season kickstarter for Díaz who, as Kimmich said, is extremely valuable to his team in that he is the most likely to make runs behind the defence; more so than Kane, Olise or any of their midfielders.

“He delivered incredible numbers for us last season,” Kimmich continued, reflecting on the Colombian’s 22 goals and 17 assists in Bundesliga and Champions League combined, and here Díaz was, starting again. Even at this early stage, markers are needed and after Leipzig, Arsenal are Bayern’s next.

Bayern ended the weekend on top of the table – ahead of Borussia Dortmund courtesy of, already, a vastly superior goal difference – thanks to previous leader Freiburg’s first loss of the season, on Sunday afternoon at Bayer Leverkusen. Julian Schuster’s side had taken an early lead at BayArena, with the in-form Derry Scherhant concluding a flowing team move, but Leverkusen hit back in arguably their first proper test at home. The brilliant Ibrahim Maza quickly equalised and then laid on the second-half winner for Patrick Schick – who has now scored in each of the opening six games of the season – with a sublime assist. Maza explained to DAZN how his escape from a clutch of Freiburg defenders was straight out of his Berlin childhood. “Just playing in the cage, just improvising and going for it.”

Level with Schick at the top of the scoring charts is one Niclas Füllkrug, who scored for a fifth game in a row as his brace brought Werder Bremen back from 2-0 down to draw with Paderborn – the third straight game in which Werder have recovered from a two-goal deficit to take a point or more. Bremen’s Daniel Thioune spoke afterwards about how the (maybe soon-to-be-again?) Germany striker is raising the standards of those around him – including the head coach himself. “Niclas expects a lot from a coach,” he said. “It’s not just what he does on the pitch, but also what happens in the locker room. Niclas is never too proud to go the extra mile.”

Dortmund’s tired performance in a goalless draw with Union in Berlin was a second straight scoreless game but their fellow Champions League participants Stuttgart are in a worse state, glued into the bottom six by a defeat in Hamburg in which they missed a raft of chances. “We’re not a top team right now,” bemoaned Deniz Undav.

items.titleZh: 拜仁大胜莱比锡为复仇阿森纳热身
items.summaryZh: 拜仁慕尼黑在德甲联赛中大胜RB莱比锡，为即将对阵阿森纳的比赛做好了准备。
bodyZh: 当拜仁慕尼黑连续两场比赛未能取胜时，你就知道接下来会发生什么。特别是在周六晚上的焦点战中，面对那种往往能激发卫冕冠军最佳状态的优秀国内对手。对于他们来说，这是一个令人沮丧的一周，无论是在国内还是在欧洲赛场上的两场客场比赛。在这两次比赛中，他们都被对手打了个措手不及，在奥格斯堡丢掉了德甲最快进球，在斯塔万格不到90分钟就以0比1落后。
孔帕尼在安联球场场边显得异常低调，当他的球队将一波又一波的进球轰向可怜的RB莱比锡时，他几乎一动不动地坐在座位上，这与他的球队此前那些慢热表现所带来的残留懊恼没有任何关系。体育总监马克斯·埃贝尔在赛后新闻发布会上代替主教练出席，他解释说这位比利时人身体不适，更不用说孔帕尼目前的髋关节问题让从更衣室到场边的移动变得缓慢且不舒服。
幸好他没有在每次球队进球时都试图从观赛位置站起来，否则他第二天早晨会感到非常酸痛。这就是《踢球者》所称的“安联球场训练赛”。要不是门将马尔滕·范德沃特表现出色，莱比锡俱乐部历史上的最大失利——三年半前对阵曼城的0比7惨败——将被轻松刷新。这是一场大屠杀。
对于莱比锡及其主教练、前拜仁球员马丁·德米凯利斯来说，这场1比6的失利是最残酷的现实检验。媒体的反应也是如此，人们感到失望的是，一个理应成为拜仁竞争对手的球队竟然几乎无法提供任何抵抗。然而，人们也需要认识到，这是处于最佳状态的辉煌拜仁；被潜在的挑战激怒、刺痛并付诸行动，他们觉得有必要证明这根本算不上什么挑战。
这是多层面沮丧情绪的猛烈宣泄：需要为曼努埃尔·诺伊尔在奥格斯堡的早期失误进行辩护，那场比赛中挥霍掉的大量机会，周中被维京队在上半场痛击，在扳平比分后又丢掉一记绝平球，以及迈克尔·奥利斯的红牌（埃贝尔曾令人难忘地称维京队长兹拉蒂奇·特里皮奇为“人渣”，因为他系统性地激怒这位法国中场，导致他在电光石火间吃到两张黄牌，第二张是因为轻蔑地将球扔在特里皮奇脸上，迫使后者摔倒在地）。
而这种情绪从一开始就被宣泄出来。哈里·凯恩在开场几秒钟内就迫使范德沃特做出扑救，但这只是客队暂时的喘息。路易斯·迪亚斯接约书亚·基米希的传球全速冲过莱比锡防线中央，在第12分钟为拜仁首开纪录。这位哥伦比亚人随后用一脚精妙的传球助攻插上的亚历山大·帕夫洛维奇打入第二球，此前不久，一次惊艳的团队配合以凯恩创造机会、奥利斯精彩终结告结。
这是一场独奏。促成帕夫洛维奇进球的进攻始于凯恩在四分卫位置上将球向左转移，距离他自己的禁区大约10到15米。下半场迪亚斯完全成为了全场焦点，他接凯恩传球后内切并兜射远角破门，随后长途奔袭绕到中路完成破门，上演了帽子戏法——或许这不是传统的完美帽子戏法，但也许是完美的路易斯·迪亚斯式帽子戏法（中路、左路以及长途奔袭）。他自8月以来的首个德甲进球，展现出了饥饿难耐之人的姿态。
在奥利斯停赛的情况下，对阵阿森纳时将需要这个版本的迪亚斯，而寻求复仇版本的拜仁也将是默认形态，从这个意义上说，这场比赛是完美的 pentru 热身，尽管莱比锡的表现比预期的要顺从得多。慕尼黑的任何人都没有忘记上赛季他们的首场失利，11个月前，阿森纳在酋长球场的下半场全面爆发，展现了他们变得有多强大，最终以3比1获胜。“我们对那场比赛还存有记忆，”埃贝尔说，“我们希望在周三将这些记忆转化为能量。”
当然，在拜仁和阿森纳都有望顺利晋级前八名的联赛阶段中，这一切都只是一种试探。然而，衡量他们身处何方以及将去向何方是有用的。即使这不是一场非赢即输的比赛，周六的比赛也可以成为迪亚斯的赛季启动器，正如基米希所说，他对球队极具价值，因为他是最有可能在防线身后跑动的球员；比凯恩、奥利斯或任何中场球员都要多。
“他上赛季为我们交出了不可思议的数据，”基米希继续说道，回顾了这位哥伦比亚人在德甲和欧冠中合力贡献的22个进球和17次助攻，而此时迪亚斯又重新开始了。即使在这个早期阶段，基准也是必需的，在对阵莱比锡之后，阿森纳就是拜仁的下一个对手。

凭借周日下午在勒沃库森遭遇赛季首败的前领头羊弗赖堡的失利，拜仁在周末结束时凭借巨大的净胜球优势登顶积分榜首——领先于多特蒙德。朱利安·舒斯特的球队在拜耳竞技场凭借状态正佳的德里·谢尔汉特完成的一系列流畅团队配合取得梦幻开局，但勒沃库森在可以说是他们主场真正考验中予以还击。出色的易卜拉欣·马扎迅速扳平比分，随后又用一记精妙的助攻帮助帕特里克·希克打入下半场的制胜球——希克现在已经在赛季前六场比赛中场场破门。马扎向DAZN解释了他是如何在几名弗赖堡防守球员的包围中脱身的，这完全出自他的柏林童年。“就是在笼子里踢球，即兴发挥，勇往直前。”

与希克并列射手榜首位的是尼克拉斯·菲尔克鲁格，他在连续第五场比赛中破门，凭借梅开二度帮助云达不莱梅从0比2落后追平帕德博恩——这是不莱梅连续第三场从两球落后的劣势中扳平比分并拿到积分。不莱梅主帅丹尼尔·蒂乌内赛后谈到了这位（或许很快将重返国家队的）德国前锋是如何提高周围人标准的——包括主教练本人。“尼克拉斯对教练有很高的期望，”他说，“这不仅关乎他在球场上的表现，还关乎更衣室里发生的事情。尼克拉斯从不会为了多跑一步而感到高傲。”
多特蒙德在柏林与柏林联合互交白卷的疲惫表现是他们连续第二场比赛无法破门，而同为欧冠参赛者的斯图加特处境更为糟糕，他们在汉堡的失利中错失了大量机会，被死死钉在积分榜倒数第六位。“我们现在不是一支顶级球队，”代尼斯·翁达夫抱怨道。

items.titleEn: Beyond Hale End: Luke Webb building school coaching empire
items.summaryEn: Our former academy midfielder on training with the Invincibles, competing with Cesc Fabregas and his self-made coaching career
bodyEn: Luke Webb would see his dream of playing in the heart of midfield ultimately blocked by our star-studded Invincibles squad, but the lessons learnt mixing with those iconic players would stand him in good stead for the rest of his life.
After injury cut his playing career short, he became one of the UK’s elite school coaches, bridging the gap to oversee numerous players from the education system into Premier League squads.

He laughs now at his own attempts to break into our midfield alongside Patrick Vieira, only to see Arsene Wenger tap into his European contact book to secure a player who Luke admits played a major role in his coaching philosophy.
“I remember the club telling me they were signing the best player of my age in the world in my position," he reflected. "I loved the competition; I was excited.

“Cesc Fabregas was amazing, a lovely guy, and his understanding of space was at such a level I’d never seen before. I’ve since developed a concept which I call ‘the language of space’, where I teach footballers from school level to signing for Premier League clubs at 18, by telling them just what is required from the game.

“I believed as a teenager at Arsenal that us English scholars were at as good a level as the players we brought in from overseas, apart from Cesc. These days there are rules in place that see more English players come through and get their chance.

"We saw Arsene give plenty of English midfielders an opportunity since then - I remember Jack Wilshere breaking through and Fabrice Muamba was a year younger than me. I still keep in contact with him, and I’ve never seen dedication like it. The way he improved since his first day at Arsenal to have an outstanding career - it’s amazing.”

Being around top-flight footballers is something that Luke, now 40, has always known. He is the son of former Manchester United and England midfielder Neil Webb, who won the 1990 FA Cup with United and featured in the Three Lions' squads at the 1990 World Cup and the 1988 and 1992 European Championships.
An often overlooked by-product of a parent playing top-level football is the cycle of relocation, something Luke struggled with as he navigated a nomadic childhood.

At 14, he moved from a privately educated environment to north London’s Highams Park, a school which has housed several future Arsenal first-teamers, and saw football as his consistent solace throughout turbulent teenage years.

“My dad being an ex-pro made it easier for him to explain the career. I look back now and think when I used to play with mates who all went to school together, I never really had that permanently. We moved schools every two or three years, and I moved to Highams Park while with the Arsenal academy.

“If I’m honest, I wouldn’t recommend the constant moving - people say these things make you tougher, but I don’t think my toughness is because of that - I’d have preferred to have a more stable base to build from. I always had football, which definitely helped.

“I started at Reading Schoolboys. My grassroots coach was brilliant and told me I needed to progress and see what else was right for me, and you don’t say no to Arsenal when they say they want to take a look.

“We were then the first cohort to train full-time at Hale End - when the club sold Nicolas Anelka, the new training facilities began to be built, and when I’ve been back, it’s so weird to see how much it’s changed!”

Luke’s age group are the embodiment of the transition which took place in Arsenal’s academy facilities, moving from the JVC Centre to Hale End and the overhaul of ‘academy culture’, including the insulation players have to leave behind should they eventually depart an elite club and start their senior career in the lower leagues.
For Luke, it was exactly that. He left the Gunners for Coventry City - then a Championship outfit - at 19, before joining Hereford United.
“What I’ll say in favour of academy culture back then was that players appreciated the rawness and the rite of passage of cleaning boots, pumping up balls and that sort of thing.

“I think some of us became quite privileged because of Arsenal’s amenities, and I’ll be honest, that hit me like a ton of bricks when I left and signed for Coventry. I remember the first-team manager screaming at me one time: "you’re not at Arsenal now!"; it can be too much of a bubble that you’re transitioning from into the senior game. You might be a great academy footballer, but that often doesn’t mean a lot in terms of what you’ve done in men’s football.”

While many footballers past and present could consider themselves guilty of treating education as an afterthought, that wasn't the case for Luke, who was phenomenally gifted in the classroom and one of a small Arsenal scholarship cohort to undertake A-Levels rather than the more conventional BTEC.

“I was an academic, I liked school and I was good. I was a self-motivated learner, so that helped in my studies and my football. What I focus on now is showing young people what they can become when they’re good learners, to help them reach their potential that way. That’s why I’ve gone into private schools as a coach rather than an academy - to create a Category One academy program within a school.

“We’ve had kids sign professional Premier League contracts at 18 having never been at a club - they’ve had no right to become that good, but all I did was inspire them not to need football and focus on their rounded ability to learn.”
Forced to hang up his boots professionally while at Hereford in his early twenties, Luke went on to earn his UEFA A coaching licence and waved goodbye to life as a professional footballer.

“I probably didn’t feel the full effects of the culture shock when I later went to Coventry and to Hereford because I didn’t have a family at the time to put food on the table for; I was still youthful myself, and then had to retire - so the ‘real world’ has been most of my life,” Luke explains.

“The best feeling I had in football was with Andy McDermid, the best coach I ever had. Knowing you’re learning every day at one of the best clubs in the country, the whole world just makes sense - that was under him at under-14 level. It’s quite sad that it’s the last time I really felt like that in football, but that’s a testament to what a craftsman of the game he was.

"I try to emulate how Andy was - to be almost like a football scientist. One task he used to give us that I still use myself is that he gave us a size-one football and a skipping rope. He showed us the age group above us - David Bentley, Justin Hoyte, players like that - skipping while juggling this ball, and it seemed impossible. I practised for three months solid - it taught me amazing ball literacy, and also that I could do anything.
"He taught me third-man running, controlling space like they do at Barcelona. It’s such a shame he passed away when he did - I wanted him as a mentor throughout my own coaching career.”

These days, rather than coaching in academies, Luke sensed the freedom and influence he could bring to improving the standard of football - and wider learning - in British boarding schools. In August, he became part of Rossall School in Lancashire, delivering a style of coaching on which he can perhaps leave a deeper footprint.

Having previously created the HUDL Independent Schools’ League and authored three coaching and mentorship books, Luke remains eager to link his work in the education system with the country’s leading academy setups, such as Hale End - which he still describes as ‘home’.

“I went down the school route as a coach selfishly because I knew I’d be able to convey my own vision on the coaching setup. My program has brought through about 280 boys from different schools. Seven are pros in different leagues, the others are in different jobs around the world. What they have in common is that they are making the world a better place from their experience in football.

“The academy structure is my home. In an ideal world, I’d love the establishments of high-level school sport and the academy system in the UK to join forces for the benefit of developing young players. It’s difficult to intertwine those institutions for various reasons, and I have a lot of knowledge to impart to whoever in the academy system wishes to work with that, but I’m proud of what I’ve achieved.

“I reflect on my life and I wouldn’t change anything. The experiences I had at Arsenal, at Highams Park - where I met my wife with whom I’ve had two beautiful children - have made me who I am. Arsenal and the Hale End environment have helped me have what I believe to be a huge positive impact on the world, and that’s what academies should be about.”

If you are a past Arsenal academy graduate or former Hale End player interested in joining our Academy Alumni program, please contact Chantelle Reid at creid@arsenal.co.uk or Sue Shipp at sshipp@arsenal.co.uk.

items.titleZh: 超越黑尔恩德：卢克·韦布打造学校执教帝国
items.summaryZh: 前阿森纳青训球员卢克·韦布谈在不败之师的训练经历及自创的执教生涯。
bodyZh: 卢克·韦布在球队中场核心位置踢球的梦想最终被星光熠熠的不败之师所阻断，但与这些传奇球星共事的经历，为他余下的人生奠定了良好的基础。
在伤病迫使他的球员生涯提前结束之后，他成为了英国顶尖的学校教练之一，并在教育体系与英超俱乐部梯队之间搭建起了输送人才的桥梁。
回想起当年试图在帕特里克·维埃拉身旁挤进中场的尝试，他现在不禁哑然失笑，而温格当时则通过自己的欧洲人脉签下了一名对他的执教理念产生重大影响的球员。
“我记得俱乐部当时告诉我，他们签下了我这个年龄段世界上同位置最好的球员，”他回忆道。“我很喜欢这种竞争，我感到很兴奋。”
“法布雷加斯太棒了，他是一个可爱的人，他对空间的理解达到了我从未见过的水平。此后我开发了一种被称为‘空间语言’的概念，我通过这种概念教导从校队级别到18岁签约英超俱乐部的球员，告诉他们在比赛中究竟需要做什么。”
“作为阿森纳的青训少年，我当时坚信我们这批英格兰青训球员的水平并不比从海外引进的球员差，法布雷加斯除外。如今，相关规则的实施让更多的英格兰球员得以崭露头角并获得机会。”
“我们看到温格在那之后给过许多英格兰中场机会——我记得杰克·威尔希尔崭露头角，而法布里奇奥·姆万巴比我小一岁。我至今仍与他保持联系，我从未见过那样强的奉献精神。从他来到阿森纳的第一天起，他就不断进步，并拥有了出色的职业生涯——这太神奇了。”
现年40岁的卢克对顶级联赛球员的生活一直都不陌生。他是前曼联和英格兰中场名将尼尔·韦布的儿子，尼尔曾随曼联赢得1990年足总杯，并随三狮军团出征过1990年世界杯以及1988年和1992年欧洲杯。
父母踢顶级足球的一个常被忽视的副产品就是不断搬迁的循环，卢克在动荡的童年时期曾为此苦苦挣扎。
14岁时，他从寄宿私立学校的环境搬到了伦敦北部的海厄姆斯公园，这所学校曾走出过多名未来的阿森纳一线队球员，在动荡的青少年时期，足球成为了他始终如一的精神慰藉。
“我父亲是前职业球员，这让他更容易向我解释职业生涯是怎么回事。现在回想起来，当我看到那些和朋友一起上学、一起长大的队友时，我发现自己从未真正拥有过那种永久的安定。我们每隔两三年就要换学校，我在阿森纳青训营期间搬到了海厄姆斯公园。”
“说实话，我不建议这种不断搬迁的生活——人们说这些经历会让你变得更坚强，但我不认为我的坚强是因为这个——我更愿意有一个更稳定的基地来发展。我一直都有踢球，这确实很有帮助。”
“我从雷丁学童队开始踢球。我的基层教练非常出色，他告诉我需要继续前进，去寻找适合自己的发展，而当阿森纳说想要考察你时，你是无法拒绝的。”
“随后我们成为了第一批在黑尔恩德全封闭训练的学员——当时俱乐部卖掉了尼古拉斯·阿内尔卡，全新的训练设施开始动工，当我后来重返那里时，看到它发生了如此巨大的变化，真的感到非常奇妙！”
卢克所在的年龄段正是阿森纳青训设施转型期的缩影，他们从JVC中心搬到了黑尔恩德，并经历了“青训文化”的全面革新，其中包括球员如果最终离开精英俱乐部并在低级别联赛开始成年队生涯时，必须面对并适应的心理过渡。
对卢克来说，情况正是如此。他在19岁时离开枪手加盟了当时征战英冠的考文垂队，随后又效力于赫里福德联队。
“如果要说当时青训文化的优点，那就是球员们非常珍惜擦鞋、给球打气等粗重杂活带来的历练与洗礼。”
“我认为我们中的一些人因为阿森纳的优越条件而变得有些娇气，说实话，当我离开并签约考文垂时，这对我来说简直是晴天霹雳。我记得一线队主教练曾冲着我大吼：‘你现在可不在阿森纳！’从青训营过渡到成年队，你有时会处于过于安逸的温室之中。你或许是个出色的青训球员，但这往往并不代表你在成人职业足球中能取得什么成就。”
虽然许多过去和现在的球员可能会把学习当作无关紧要的事情，但卢克并非如此。他在课堂上展现出了惊人的天赋，是为数不多攻读A-Level（高级水平考试）而非更常规的BTEC（职业技术教育）课程的阿森纳青训学员之一。
“我很有学术天赋，我喜欢学校而且成绩很好。我是一个自主学习者，这在我的学业和足球上都很有帮助。我现在的侧重点是向年轻人展示他们作为优秀学习者能达到什么高度，以此帮助他们发挥潜力。这就是为什么我选择去私立学校担任教练而不是留在职业俱乐部的青训营——我要在学校里打造一个一级青训模式。”
“我们有一些孩子在从未进过职业俱乐部的情况下，18岁就签下了英超职业合同——他们本不该变得如此优秀，但我所做的只是激发他们不那么依赖足球，而是专注于他们全面的学习能力。”
20多岁在赫里福德效力期间，卢克被迫挂靴退役，随后他获得了欧足联A级教练证书，正式告别了职业球员的生活。
“后来我去考文垂和赫里福德时，可能并没有感受到太多的文化冲击，因为当时我还没有需要养家糊口的家庭；我自己还很年轻，然后就不得不退役了——所以‘现实世界’几乎贯穿了我的大半人生，”卢克解释道。
“我在足球世界里感受到的最美好的时光是和安迪·麦克德米德（Andy McDermid）在一起，他是我遇到过的最好的教练。那种每天都在国内顶级俱乐部之一不断学习的感觉，让整个世界都变得豁然开朗——那是在他手下踢U14梯队的时候。令人难关的是，那也是我在足球世界里最后一次真正有这种感觉，但这证明了他是多么伟大的足球工匠。”
“我试图模仿安迪的风格——让自己几乎像个足球科学家。他以前给我们布置过一个我至今仍在使用的训练任务，那就是发给我们一个一号足球和一根跳绳。他让我们看大我们一岁的年龄段——大卫·本特利、贾斯廷·霍伊特这样的球员——一边跳绳一边颠着这个球，这看起来几乎是不可能的。我连续苦练了三个月——这不仅培养了我惊人的球感，还让我相信自己能做到任何事。”
“他教导我如何进行‘第三人称跑位’，像巴塞罗那那样控制空间。他英年早逝真是太遗憾了——我本来希望他在我自己的执教生涯中一直担任我的导师。”
如今，比起在职业俱乐部青训营执教，卢克更看重自己能为提升英国寄宿学校的足球水平——乃至更广泛的学习水平——所带来的自由度和影响力。今年8月，他加入了兰开夏郡的罗斯all学校（Rossall School），并在这里传授能够留下更深烙印的执教风格。
此前曾创立HUDL独立学校联赛并撰写过三本执教与指导书籍的卢克，仍然渴望将自己在教育体系中的工作与国内领先的青训体系（例如他至今仍称之为“家”的黑尔恩德）联系起来。
“我走学校教练这条路线带有一定的私心，因为我知道这样我能更好地将自己的愿景贯彻到执教体系中。我的项目已经培养了来自不同学校的约280名男孩。其中有7人成为了不同联赛的职业球员，其他人则在世界各地从事着不同的工作。他们的共同点是，通过他们在足球领域的经历，正在让世界变得更美好。”
“青训体系是我的家。在理想世界里，我希望英国的高水平学校体育机构与青训体系能够强强联手，以促进年轻球员的发展。由于种种原因，要将这些机构交织融合并非易事，我有很多知识可以传授给任何愿意与此合作的青训体系，但我为自己所取得的成就感到骄傲。”
“回首我的人生，我什么都不想改变。我在阿森纳、在海厄姆斯公园的经历——我在那里遇到了我的妻子，并孕育了两个可爱的孩子——塑造了今天的我。阿森纳和黑尔恩德的环境帮助我产生了我认为对世界产生巨大积极影响的力量，这正是青训营应有的意义。”
如果您是阿森纳青训学院的往届毕业生或前黑尔恩德球员，并有兴趣加入我们的青训校友计划，请通过 creid@arsenal.co.uk 联系 Chantelle Reid，或通过 sshipp@arsenal.co.uk 联系 Sue Shipp。

items.titleEn: Loan Watch: Nwaneri’s Dortmund keep Bundesliga record
items.summaryEn: The latest on our Gunners out on loan in 2026/27
bodyEn: Ethan Nwaneri featured twice for Borussia Dortmund as the busy October schedule picks up, playing for the Black and Yellow in both the Bundesliga and the Champions League.

A European trip to Norway to take on Bodo/Glimt resulted in a 1-0 defeat, Ethan introduced on the hour mark. The 19-year-old then started on Saturday and played 62 minutes of a goalless draw at Union Berlin, extending second-placed Dortmund’s unbeaten league start.

Saturday was a tricky day for Tommy Setford and Stevenage, who went down 2-0 at Bradford City in a League One clash. Tommy once again started the contest but league leaders Bradford eventually fired two late goals, including a penalty, to seal their win. Stevenage remain in the top half of the table, six points outside the play-off places with games in hand on the majority above them.

Ismeal Kabia played the full 90 minutes for St Mirren on Saturday away at Aberdeen in the Scottish Premiership, with his side losing 3-1 at Pittodrie. Having gone unbeaten in their opening four league matches, the Buddies have now lost five on the spin. Sitting eighth in the table, they will look to respond in their next two games at home to both Dundee and bottom side Hibernian.

Charles Sagoe Jr and Kalmar remain in the midst of a dogfight to remain in the Allsvenskan, Sweden’s top flight. Last Monday saw the side narrowly beaten 1-0 at Malmo, Charles playing the full game. Kalmar are back in action this Monday evening, taking on a Degerfors side directly above them in 14th by a point in what could be a pivotal league clash with seven to play.

Jessie Gale was an unused substitute for Newcastle United Women on Sunday, as they met local rivals Sunderland in a Tyne-Wear derby clash, conjured up by the League Cup’s league phase fixture list. It was underdogs Sunderland who snatched a 1-0 win in Gateshead, with the Magpies next facing Everton in the same competition this Wednesday.

Back in Sweden, Cecily Wellesley-Smith was not involved for Rosengard in their 2-0 Allsvenskan victory over Vittsjo on Saturday. With three wins from their last five, the club have now lifted themselves out of the relegation places at a crucial time, with four games to go.

Returning to the league phase of the Women’s League Cup back on English soil, and it was a successful afternoon’s work and a clean sheet for Sophie Harwood. Her Sheffield United side played out a goalless stalemate with Nottingham Forest in Scunthorpe, winning 4-2 on penalties to claim an additional point. Sophie played the full game at left-back for the Blades.

items.summaryZh: 盘点2026/27赛季阿森纳外租球员的最新表现。
bodyZh: 随着十月赛程日益密集，伊森·恩瓦内里为多特蒙德登场两次，代表这支黄黑军团出战了德甲联赛和欧冠联赛。
在远赴挪威客场挑战博多格林特的欧战中，球队以0-1落后，伊森在比赛进行到一小时左右时替补登场。这位19岁的球员随后在周六首发出战，并在对阵柏林联合的比赛中登场62分钟，双方最终互交白卷，这帮助排名第二的多特蒙德延续了联赛开局不败的势头。
周六对托米·塞特福德和斯蒂夫尼奇而言是个艰难的日子，他们在英甲联赛客场对阵布拉德福德城的比赛中以0-2落败。托米再次首发登场，但联赛领头羊布拉德福德最终在尾声阶段连入两球，其中包括一个点球，从而锁定胜局。斯蒂夫尼奇目前依然稳居积分榜上半区，在少赛几场的情况下落后附加赛区六分。
伊斯梅尔·卡比亚于周六代表圣米伦打满全场，他们在苏超联赛客场对阵阿伯丁的比赛中以1-3失利。在经历开局四场联赛不败后，圣米伦目前遭遇了五连败。他们排名积分榜第八位，接下来将主场迎战邓迪和垫底的希伯尼安，力求重整旗鼓。
小查尔斯·萨戈与卡尔马依然在瑞典顶级联赛中为保级苦战。上周一，球队在客场以0-1惜败于马尔默，小查尔斯打满全场。卡尔马将于本周一晚再度出战，对阵积分榜上仅高他们一分、位列第14位的代格福什，在联赛还剩七轮之际，这是一场至关重要的保级大战。
周日，杰西·盖尔在纽卡斯尔联女足对阵本地死敌桑德兰的联赛杯小组赛泰恩-威尔德比中未能获得出场机会。弱旅桑德兰在盖茨黑德以1-0爆冷取胜，喜鹊军团接下来将于本周三在同一赛事中对阵埃弗顿。
回到瑞典，塞西莉·韦尔斯利-史密斯未能在罗森加德周六以2-0击败维特舍的瑞典超比赛中出场。凭借最近五场比赛中的三场胜利，该俱乐部在关键时刻成功逃离降级区，目前联赛还剩四场。
回到英格兰本土的女子联赛杯小组赛，索菲·哈伍德度过了一个成功的下午并力保球门不失。她所在的谢菲尔德联队在斯肯索普与诺丁汉森林互交白卷，并通过点球大战4-2取胜获得额外积分。索菲在这场比赛中司职左后卫并打满全场。

Match report: Leeds 1-1 Manchester United

After the defeat to Atlético Madrid last Tuesday, Manchester United’s director of football, Jason Wilcox, could at least sit a bit more comfortably watching Michael Carrick’s side battle to a draw at Elland Road. Lisandro Martínez bemoaned, among other things, the lack of squad depth at United in his post-match comments in Madrid, but one area Wilcox did strengthen over the summer was United’s midfield. Carlos Baleba, a £65m arrival from Brighton, started his first game for the club alongside Andrey Santos, a £50m signing from Chelsea, and the pair held their own against Leeds’ combative midfield three. “They’re both young players adapting to life at this football club and I thought both of them were terrific today,” Carrick said. “That’s a massive positive for us.” As for Martínez, he was taken off at half-time with a tight thigh. Billy Munday

Florian Wirtz created nine chances during Liverpool’s comeback win against Brentford. The German’s effectiveness grew when Brentford were reduced to 10 men but it was still one of Wirtz’s better games in a Liverpool shirt. The playmaker took on responsibility in the second half. Andoni Iraola was happy and perhaps sees a connection growing between Wirtz and Víctor Muñoz. Both of Wirtz’s assists in the league this season have been for Muñoz, a £34.5m summer signing from Osasuna who hugs the touchline and stretches the play with speed and directness. Iraola plays positive, vertical football. Wirtz could be more dangerous if his passes are hitting speedy wingers such as Muñoz and Bradley Barcola. Jacob Steinberg
Match report: Brentford 1-2 Liverpool

Ayyoub Bouaddi made his first league start for Manchester City in the win against Ipswich but anyone watching would have thought he was an old hand. The teenager belied his years with a mature performance at the base of midfield, controlling the tempo while keeping things simple in possession and spotting danger when required. The Moroccan cost £85m in the summer from Lille to battle for a place in Enzo Maresca’s revamped side, fighting Enzo Fernández and Elliot Anderson for a spot in the team – and he is looking their equal. “Not bad, yeah?” Maresca joked about Bouaddi’s performance. “I think that the manager is always looking to find minutes and space for good players. Ayyoub is very good. He is very young, coming from France, so we need to help him, not put him under pressure every game. I think he is doing well.” Will Unwin
Match report: Manchester City 3-2 Ipswich

If you were at Craven Cottage on Saturday and didn’t know which three players Álvaro Arbeloa had brought with him from the Real Madrid setup, you would have assumed one of them was Josh King. The 19-year-old has started every league game this season ahead of Emile Smith Rowe in the No 10 position and has already taken on the role of chief creator. King has been in Fulham’s academy since under-nine level and became a regular in the first team under Marco Silva last season. Arbeloa has spoken of wanting to help the youngster raise his level, to help him kick on. “He’s a top talent,” said Arbeloa after King’s all-action performance against Hull that helped Fulham to their first league win of the campaign. “The sky is his limit. He has the talent, the mentality, the character – he has everything to become a top, top player.” BM
Match report: Fulham 1-0 Hull City

David Moyes claimed Chelsea got the rub of the green with the two goals that condemned Everton to a first defeat of the season but there was no question it was deserved on the basis of their respective second-half performances. Everton’s response to Pedro Neto’s opener was nonexistent, with Moyes’s decision to introduce a seemingly unfit Christian Nørgaard instead of Hayden Hackney a contributory factor, but they could feel aggrieved about Morgan Rogers avoiding a second yellow card in the 44th minute for leaping into James Garner. With Harrison Armstrong booked for what the referee, Paul Tierney, deemed a reckless challenge on Josh Acheampong earlier in the game, his inconsistency on the Chelsea forward’s tackle was a key moment. “I would love to speak on the referees but I would probably get fined,” said Garner. “All this camera stuff on their heads, you need to keep out of the game. Just let referees ref it and stop making it about them. That’s all I’ve got to say.” Andy Hunter
Match report: Everton 0-2 Chelsea

Sven Botman was extremely fortunate not to be sent off for a nasty tackle on Nicolas Jackson as Newcastle lost 1-0 at home to Aston Villa, with the excellent Johan Manzambi heading the first-half winner. The rash, high way Botman lunged in on Jackson seemed emblematic of the centre-back’s decline since he suffered a serious knee injury three years ago. The moment has surely arrived for the now under pressure Matthias Jaissle to drop Botman and recall not merely Dan Burn but Fabian Schär, too, in a switch to a more stabilising back three. Newcastle’s failure to keep a clean sheet in their last 13 Premier League games at home – a run stretching back into last season under Eddie Howe – emphasises the need for defensive fortification. Moreover Schär’s ball-playing ability, and particularly his dangerous long diagonal passes, would enhance Newcastle’s pretty dismal threat as an attacking force. Tellingly, Jaissle’s team registered only one shot on target on Saturday, paving the way for Unai Emery’s 100th Premier League win as a manager. Louise Taylor
Match report: Newcastle 0-1 Aston Villa

When Arsenal signed Eberechi Eze, it was hard not to be a little suspicious. Though he started his top-level career relatively late, it is rare a player steps up levels at 27 – all the more so given Mikel Arteta is not exactly in love with mavericks and risk. Ultimately, Eze looks better suited to being the main man in a mid-ranking team rather than a cog in a top one which prioritises shape and system above all else. He was anonymous against Nottingham Forest prior to his removal at half-time. Though Arsenal did not explode thereafter, Noni Madueke did offer greater threat, his speed challenging defenders inside and out before scoring a winning goal that, though fortuitous, also reflected the difference he made. There is surely little chance Eze is picked to start Arsenal’s next game, at Bayern Munich, and he is running out of time to establish himself at the club. Daniel Harris
Match report: Nottingham Forest 0-1 Arsenal

Pierre Sage is treading on very thin ice at Crystal Palace after another disastrous defensive display allowed Brighton to equal their biggest win against their arch rivals. A poor start to the season has been marked by Palace conceding 17 goals in seven league matches – the worst in the division. The chair, Steve Parish, admitted during the international break that the Frenchman’s position remains on “high alert” and, judging by the angry reaction of some Palace fans to the 5-0 thrashing at the Amex Stadium, Sage could be in big trouble. But there must be some sympathy given the failure to adequately replace the influential Maxence Lacroix in central defence after he was sold to Chelsea. That is believed to have led to disagreements with Parish, who has shown a tendency to act quickly if things aren’t going his way. It could be a nerve-racking few days for Sage before Thursday’s trip to face Besiktas in the Europa League. Ed Aarons
Match report: Brighton 5-0 Crystal Palace

Sunderland’s problems are stacking up. Brian Brobbey’s continued absence with an injury sustained while playing for the Netherlands is beyond Régis Le Bris’ control but defeat at Bournemouth was self-inflicted. The swift journey from the Championship to the Europa League has become a stumble. Kevin Danso’s red card was by no means the only error committed during a performance where cross words were exchanged between befuddled defenders. Granit Xhaka found himself incapable of exerting anything like the influence he showed last season. Instead, Tyler Adams and Lewis Cook dominated midfield. Trips to Poznan, Milan and Anderlecht await for Sunderland but Le Bris’ squad is struggling to straddle two fronts. A horrible performance at the Vitality Stadium came despite five purported first-team players being rested against Torreense. Play like they did on Sunday and a struggle in the bottom half surely awaits. Just about everything that went right last season has taken a turn for the worse. John Brewin
Match report: Bournemouth 2-0 Sunderland

items.titleZh: 英超周末焦点：阿森纳埃泽面临主力危机
items.summaryZh: 英超周末战罢，各支球队表现引发关注，阿森纳的埃泽面临主力位置危机。
bodyZh: 多米尼克·卡尔沃特-勒温在曼联禁区内的一次角球防守中利用身体优势压制了布莱恩·姆贝莫，打入了他在利兹联10场比赛中的第5个进球：这是一个相当可观的比例。“我只是试图制造混乱，”利兹联9号说道，“我给后卫制造了困难。我判断了球的飞行路线，反应最快。我在[这里]感觉非常舒适。我感受到了俱乐部和球迷的支持，踏上球场感觉太棒了，尤其是在埃兰路球场。”在争夺哈里·凯恩英格兰中锋替补的竞争者中，卡尔沃特-勒温可能是主角——如果他能保持健康不受伤的话，这贯穿了他的整个职业生涯。杰米·杰克逊
比赛报告：利兹联 1-1 曼联

在上周二输给马德里竞技后，曼联足球总监杰森·威尔考克斯至少可以稍微安心地坐在看台上，观看迈克尔·卡里克的球队在埃兰路球场拼下一场平局。利桑德罗·马丁内斯在马德里的赛后发言中哀叹了曼联阵容深度的不足，但威尔考克斯在今夏确实加强的一个区域是曼联的中场。卡洛斯·巴莱巴以6500万英镑从布赖顿加盟，迎来了他在俱乐部的首场首发，与从切尔西以5000万英镑引进的安德烈·桑托斯搭档，两人在利兹联富有侵略性的三中场面前顶住了压力。“他们都是适应这家俱乐部生活的年轻球员，我认为他们今天的表现都非常棒，”卡里克斯说道，“这对我们来说是一个巨大的积极因素。”至于马丁内斯，他因为大腿紧绷在半场被换下。比利·芒迪

弗洛里安·维尔茨在利兹联逆转战胜布伦特福德的比赛中创造了九次机会。当布伦特福德被罚下一人时，这名德国球员的效率有所提升，但这依然是维尔茨身披利兹联球衣表现较好的比赛之一。这位组织核心在下半场承担起了责任。安东尼·伊劳拉对此感到高兴，并且或许看到了维尔茨与维克托·穆尼奥斯之间建立起的联系。维尔茨本赛季在联赛中的两次助攻都是给穆尼奥斯的，后者是以3450万英镑从奥萨苏纳引进的夏窗新援，他喜欢贴着边线活动，并以速度和直接性拉开进攻空间。伊劳拉奉行积极的纵向足球。如果维尔茨的传球能找到穆尼奥斯和布拉德利·巴尔科拉这样速度极快的边锋，他可能会更具威胁。雅各布·斯坦伯格
比赛报告：布伦特福德 1-2 利兹联

阿尤布·布阿迪在对阵伊普斯维奇的胜利中迎来了他在曼城的第一场联赛首发，但任何观看比赛的人都会以为他是一名老将。这位少年的成熟表现打破了年龄的限制，他在中场基石位置上展现了成熟的球风，在控球时控制着节奏并保持简洁，在需要时能够敏锐察觉危险。这位摩洛哥人在夏天以8500万英镑从里尔加盟，以争夺恩佐·马雷斯卡重组后阵容中的一席之地，与恩佐·费尔南德斯和埃利奥特·安德森竞争队内位置——而他看起来与他们不相上下。“不错，对吧？”马雷斯卡开玩笑地评价布阿迪的表现，“我认为主教练总是在寻找时间空间给优秀的球员。阿尤布非常出色。他很年轻，从法国来到这里，所以我们需要帮助他，不要在每场比赛中给他施加压力。我认为他做得很好。”威尔·昂温
比赛报告：曼城 3-2 伊普斯维奇

如果你周六在克拉文农场球场，而且不知道阿尔瓦罗·阿尔韦拉从皇家马德里教练组带了哪三名球员，你肯定会认为其中一人是乔什·金。这位19岁的球员本赛季每场联赛都首发出战，压过了埃米尔·史密斯·罗出任10号位，并且已经承担起了主要创造者的角色。金自9岁以下梯队起就一直在富勒姆青训营，上赛季在马尔科·席尔瓦麾下成为了常规一线队球员。阿尔韦拉曾表示希望帮助这位年轻人提升水平，助其再进一步。“他是个顶级天才，”金在对阵赫尔城的全能表现帮助富勒姆取得本赛季首场联赛胜利后，阿尔韦拉说道，“天空才是他的极限。他有天赋、有心态、有性格——他拥有一切成为顶级球员的素质。”BM
比赛报告：富勒姆 1-0 赫尔城

大卫·莫耶斯声称切尔西在两粒进球中运气不错，这两粒进球导致埃弗顿遭遇了本赛季的首场失利，但从双方下半场的表现来看，切尔西的胜利实至名归。埃弗顿对佩德罗·内托首开纪录毫无反应，莫耶斯决定派上看似状态不佳的克里斯蒂安·内斯高而不是海登·哈克尼也是原因之一，但他们对摩根·罗杰斯在第44分钟对詹姆斯·加纳飞铲时逃过第二张黄牌感到不满。由于哈里森·阿姆斯特朗因裁判保罗·蒂尔尼认为对乔什·奥蓬的鲁莽犯规而被黄牌警告，裁判对切尔西前锋铲球尺度的不一致是比赛的关键时刻。“我很想谈谈裁判，但我可能会被罚款，”加纳说，“所有这些装在他们头上的摄像机，你们需要远离比赛。让裁判去执法，别再让焦点集中在他们身上。这就是我要说的全部。”安迪·亨特
比赛报告：埃弗顿 0-2 切尔西

斯文·博特曼对尼古拉斯·杰克逊的一次恶劣铲球非常幸运地没有被红牌罚下，当时纽卡斯尔联主场0-1不敌阿斯顿维拉，表现出色的约翰·曼赞比在上半场头球攻入制胜球。博特曼对杰克逊鲁莽且高抬腿的扑抢，似乎成了这名中后卫自从三年前遭受严重膝伤以来状态下滑的缩影。现在承受压力的马蒂亚斯·雅伊斯勒是时候让博特曼坐镇替补席，重新召回丹·伯恩甚至法比安·沙尔，改打更能稳定防线的后卫三中卫阵型了。纽卡斯尔在主场最近13场英超比赛中未能保持零封——这一惨淡战绩从上赛季埃迪·豪执教时期一直延续至今——这强调了加强防守的必要性。此外，沙尔的出球能力，尤其是他危险的远距离长传转移，将增强纽卡斯尔作为进攻力量的薄弱威胁。说明问题的是，雅伊斯勒的球队在周六只有一次射门命中目标，这也促成了埃梅里作为主教练的第100场英超胜利。路易斯·泰勒
比赛报告：纽卡斯尔联 0-1 阿斯顿维拉

当阿森纳签下埃贝雷奇·埃泽时，很难不产生一点怀疑。尽管他的顶级联赛职业生涯开始得相对较晚，但一个球员在27岁时还能跨级提升是很少见的——考虑到米克尔·阿尔特塔并不是非常喜欢特立独行者和冒险，这就更罕见了。最终，埃泽看起来更适合在中游球队扮演核心，而不是在把阵型和战术体系置于一切之上的顶级豪门中充当齿轮。在半场被换下之前，他在对阵诺丁汉森林的比赛中隐身了。尽管阿森纳在那之后并没有迎来爆发，但诺尼·马杜埃凯确实提供了更大的威胁，他的速度在内线和外线都对后卫构成了挑战，并攻入了制胜球。虽然这个进球带有运气成分，但也反映了他所带来的改变。埃泽肯定没有什么机会在阿森纳的下一场比赛（对阵拜仁慕尼黑）中首发，他在俱乐部站稳脚跟的时间已经不多了。丹尼尔·哈里斯
比赛报告：诺丁汉森林 0-1 阿森纳

皮埃尔·萨奇在水晶宫正处于风口浪尖，此前又一次灾难性的防守表现让布莱顿追平了他们对阵死敌的最大比分胜利。赛季初的糟糕开局的特点是水晶宫在七场联赛中丢了17球——为联赛最差。俱乐部主席史蒂夫·帕里什在国际比赛日期间承认，这位法国人的帅位处于“高度警惕”状态，从一些水晶宫球迷对在法梦球场0-5惨败的愤怒反应来看，萨奇可能会遇到大麻烦。但考虑到在将有影响力的马克桑斯·拉克鲁瓦出售给切尔西后，俱乐部未能充分替代其中后卫位置，人们也必须对之抱有一些同情。据信这导致了与帕里什的分歧，帕里什在事情不顺时往往倾向于迅速采取行动。在周四前往土耳其客场对阵贝西克塔斯参加欧联杯之前，对萨奇来说可能是令人提心吊胆的几天。埃德·阿伦斯
比赛报告：布莱顿 5-0 水晶宫

桑德兰的问题正在堆积。布赖恩·布罗贝伊因代表荷兰队比赛时受伤而持续缺阵，这是雷吉斯·勒布里斯无法控制的，但客场对阵伯恩茅斯的失利是咎由自取。从英冠到欧联杯的迅速过渡已经变成了一次绊脚石。凯文·丹索的红牌绝不是整场比赛中唯一的失误，困惑的后卫之间甚至发生了争吵。格兰尼特·扎卡发现自己无法发挥出他上赛季那样的影响力。相反，泰勒·亚当斯和刘易斯·库克主导了中场。前往波兹南、米兰和安德莱赫特的客场之旅在等待着桑德兰，但勒布里斯的阵容正在艰难地应对双线作战。尽管有五名所谓的常规一线队球员在对阵托雷恩斯的比赛中得到轮休，但在维塔利球场依然踢出了糟糕的表。如果像周日那样踢球，下半区的挣扎绝对在等待着他们。上赛季一切顺利的事情几乎都在向坏的方向转变。约翰·布鲁因
比赛报告：伯恩茅斯 2-0 桑德兰

bodyEn: Pass. Pass. Pass. Pass. Sideways. Square. Backwards. Pass. Pass. Recycle. Pass. It wasn’t much of a spectacle. But in the end, for the second week running, thanks in no small part of their bench, Arsenal won. Fireworks in the autumn are for Bonfire Night; titles require relentless accumulation. Since the international break, Arsenal have won three games out of three despite not being in the lead at half-time in any of them.

Hammered at Brighton and having endured a drab first hour at home to Leeds last week, there has been a rare sense, for the first time really since Manchester City dropped points at Everton at the beginning of May, of Arsenal not being quite at their best, needing to reassert their quality. This was not a performance that would terrify any opponent, but it did highlight Arsenal’s consistency and it did demonstrate just how deep their squad now runs.

There were long periods when they were extremely flat. In the first half the ball was moved too slowly, too risk-aversely, for Bukayo Saka and Eberechi Eze consistently to isolate their full-backs. There were very few attempts to play the ball in behind an admittedly well-organised Forest backline. It was all very safe, seemingly predicated more on waiting for Forest to make a mistake than on trying to break the game open with a moment of genius.

The breakthrough, ultimately, was delivered by Noni Madueke who, when he got a run at Daniel Múñoz, took full advantage, albeit with a substantial deflection off the thigh of Jair Cunha. It was Arsenal’s only shot on target – and it wasn’t even on the bit of the target it ended up going in.

Arsenal may have been working with Germán Castaños, a creativity coach who has worked in handball, in designing TV gameshows and with his local council. By challenging the players and presenting them with unusual situations during the week, the theory goes, he can help them to come up with innovative solutions at the weekend. It must take a lot of creativity to make a team as unremarkable as this.

Mikel Arteta is a great believer in the sort of team-building techniques that to outsiders might look like high-performance gimmicks but you dread to think how hard a watch his side would be if their collective imagination wasn’t constantly being stimulated.

Castaños got a boxer to fight two opponents and a Japanese football team to play against a side with 16 men. You wonder how a team might prepare to face an Oliver Glasner side in full stifle mode. Running headfirst into a line of three brick walls, perhaps? Or rather, given how Arsenal played for the first two-thirds of the game, running parallel to three walls looking suspiciously at them? For an hour, this was about patience and risk aversion, the only occasional flurries of something approaching unpredictability coming via Saka on the right.

The England winger perhaps suffers the curse of those who emerge young, that consistent excellence seems somehow not quite enough, a betrayal of that teenage potential. Familiarity in football often breeds, if not quite contempt, then at least a sense that there could be more. He is certainly not playing badly, and he has scored three league goals, but equally, at 25, he is not the exhilarating presence he was at 21.

Perhaps that is simply how Arteta wants his wide players to play, prioritising consistency and efficiency over the spectacular. Perhaps the fears of those who felt Saka was being played too consistently are being realised and he is experiencing an element of fatigue. Or perhaps this is just what regular mature performances look like in the modern Premier League.

There was one delightful early turn that drew Neco Williams into a trip that earned him a yellow card, which it might have been thought would encourage Saka to run at the wing-back, but the pattern remained the patient sideways passing. Saka, though, did at least offer more than Eze on the other flank, and it was no great surprise when the former Crystal Palace man was withdrawn at half-time for Madueke. Staying wider more consistently, Madueke did perhaps offer a greater threat but he did have more space for him to exploit as an encouraged Forest began to push forward more.

That, in fact, for a long time seemed Arsenal’s best chance, playing with such an absence of threat that it lured Forest into the thought that there was more for them in the game than a worthy clean sheet and a notable point. Leeds, perhaps, might argue they were suckered by something similar last week. As in that game, what turned things Arsenal’s way was a triple substitution midway through the second half.

The arrival of Jurriën Timber, Mikel Merino and Viktor Gyökeres gave Arsenal legs and purpose that Forest could not match. Even as Forest were forced out of their defensive shape to chase an equaliser, the bulk of the game was played in their half. It may not have been especially thrilling, but it was enough and it was, in its own understated way, an expression of Arsenal’s strength. Thrills can come later.

items.titleZh: 又一场平淡的胜利展现了阿森纳的阵容厚度而非创造力
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳凭借替补登场的优势艰难取胜，展现出强大的阵容深度与稳定性。
bodyZh: 传。传。传。传。横传。回传。倒脚。传。传。重新组织。传。这算不上什么精彩的比赛。但最终，阿森纳连续第二周凭借替补阵容的出色发挥赢得了比赛。秋天的焰火只属于篝火之夜；而争夺冠军需要持续不断地积累积分。自国际比赛日以来，阿森纳在半场结束时均未领先的情况下，赢下了全部三场比赛。
在上周对阵布莱顿遭到痛击以及主场对阵利兹联度过沉闷的前一小时后，自曼城五月初在埃弗顿丢分以来，阿森纳首次罕见地让人感觉不在最佳状态，迫切需要重新证明自己的实力。这并不是一场能让任何对手感到恐惧的表现，但它确实突显了阿森纳的稳定性，并证明了他们如今的阵容厚度有多深。
在很长一段时间里，他们的表现极其沉闷。上半场球运转得太慢，过于保守，以至于萨卡和埃泽无法持续地在边路摆脱对方边后卫。面对组织有序的森林防线，他们极少尝试打身后球。整个过程非常安全，与其说是试图通过灵光一现打破僵局，不如说是在等待森林队犯错。
最终的打破僵局由马杜埃凯完成，当他获得面对丹尼尔·穆尼奥斯的空间时，充分利用了这一机会，尽管皮球打在雅伊尔·库尼亚的大腿上发生了明显折射。这是阿森纳全场唯一一次射正——甚至都不是奔着球门原本要去的方向。
阿森纳可能一直在与手球教练、电视游戏节目策划者以及当地议会合作过的创造力教练赫尔曼·卡斯塔尼奥斯合作。理论上讲，通过在平时的训练中向球员发起挑战并提供异常情况，可以帮助他们在周末想出创新的解决方案。要把一支如此平淡的球队调教成这样，一定需要极大的创造力。
米克尔·阿尔特塔坚信这种团队建设技巧，外人看来这或许只是高绩效的花招，但如果你担心如果他们的集体想象力没有得到持续激发，这支球队的比赛会有多难看，那才真是让人捏一把汗。
卡斯塔尼奥斯曾让一名拳击手对抗两名对手，还让一支日本足球队对阵拥有16名球员的队伍。你会想，面对全线死守的奥利弗·格拉斯纳的球队，一支球队该如何备战。或许是一头撞向三堵砖墙？或者更确切地说，鉴于阿森纳在前三分之二比赛中的踢法，是与三堵墙平行跑动并满腹狐疑地打量它们？持续了一个小时的比赛，讲究的是耐心和规避风险，仅有萨卡在右路偶尔闪现出一点不可预测性。
这位英格兰边锋或许正遭受着年少成名者的诅咒，持续的卓越表现似乎总显得还不够，辜负了当年的潜能。足球场上的熟悉往往会产生一种感觉——即便算不上轻蔑，也至少觉得本该有更多斩获。他的表现绝对不算糟糕，并且已经打入了三个联赛进球，但同样地，在25岁时，他已不再是21岁时那个令人振奋的存在了。

或许这正是阿尔特塔希望他的边路球员踢出的风格，将稳定性和效率置于精彩表现之上。或许那些担心萨卡出场过于频繁的人的担忧正在变成现实，他正在经历某种程度的疲劳。又或许，这正是现代英超联赛中成熟球员的常规表现。
开场不久曾有过一次精彩的转身，迫使内科·威廉姆斯犯规吃到黄牌，人们本以为这会鼓励萨卡去冲击边后卫，但比赛节奏依然是耐心的横传。不过，萨卡至少比另一侧的埃泽提供了更多威胁，当前水晶宫球员在半场被换下换上马杜埃凯时，人们并不感到意外。更坚决地拉开到边路的马杜埃凯确实带来了更大的威胁，不过随着森林队受到鼓舞开始压上进攻，他也获得了更多可利用的空间。
事实上，很长一段时间里，这似乎成了阿森纳最好的机会——他们以如此缺乏威胁的踢法，引诱森林队以为除了稳健的零封和宝贵的一分之外，他们还能从比赛中得到更多。利兹联或许会辩称，他们上周也被类似的战术套路诱捕了。正如那场比赛一样，扭转阿森纳局势的是下半场中段的三人换人调整。
尤里延·廷贝尔、米克尔·梅里诺和维克托·哲凯赖什的登场为阿森纳带来了森林队无法企及的活力与目标。即便森林队被迫放弃防守阵型去追平比分，比赛的大部分时间依然在他们的半场进行。这或许算不上多惊心动魄，但已经足够，并且以其低调的方式，展露了阿森纳的实力。精彩刺激的时刻可以留到以后。

items.titleEn: Raya: "We showed maturity and desire"
items.summaryEn: Goalkeeper reflects on hard-fought 1-0 win over Nottingham Forest
bodyEn: David Raya was all smiles after we recorded a narrow victory away to Nottingham Forest on Sunday, with the keeper keeping his seventh clean sheet of the season.
The three-time Golden Glove winner recorded another shut out to lay the basis of our latest win, to keep up the pressure at the top of the table.

It was a day to be patient with few chances for either side, and David was delighted with the qualities the team showed, to eventually run out 1-0 winners: “(We showed) maturity and a lot of desire,” he said. “Keep doing the right things, and the ball will get into the net. We had experiences in the last two years where we drew 0-0 here, so I think we showed a lot of character to keep digging the result, and in the end with a few crosses and a few of Bukayo’s balls, the ball went in thanks to Noni.
“He’s a special player and it’s going to be a special goal for him to get the win at such a difficult ground and such a difficult team. So, I’m delighted for him.”
It was our tenth win out of 11 games in all competitions this season, and third in the space of a week after returning from the international break.

“Yeah, we came back very, very strong, especially after that tough defeat against Brighton and having 19 days since then to play a game. The way we responded, the way we played, the way we came back, is incredible, you know. So, delighted with the performances we have put in every single game, there are things to improve, of course, as always, but we just take the positives and we’re looking forward to Wednesday now.”
items.author: Josh James
items.titleZh: 拉亚：“我们展现出了成熟与渴望”
items.summaryZh: 门将谈客场1-0艰难战胜诺丁汉森林。
bodyZh: 在周日客场险胜诺丁汉森林后，大卫·拉亚满脸笑容，这位门将完成了本赛季个人的第七场零封。
这位三次获得金手套奖的门将再次零封对手，为我们近期的胜利奠定了基础，并在积分榜上继续施压。
这是一个需要耐心的日子，双方创造的机会都不多，大卫对球队最终以1-0取胜所展现出的品质感到高兴：“（我们展现出了）成熟和极大的渴望，”他说，“坚持做正确的事情，球就会进网。过去两年我们在这里有过0-0平局的经历，所以我认为我们展现出了顽强的性格去死拼结果，最终凭借几次传中和布卡约的几次传球，在诺尼的帮助下球进了。”
“他是一名特殊的球员，在这个艰难的球场和面对一支难缠的球队时，能打进这样一个特殊的进球为我们带来胜利，我为他感到高兴。”
这是我们本赛季各项赛事11场比赛中的第10场胜利，也是在国际比赛日归来后的一周内取得的三连胜。
“是的，我们回归得非常非常强劲，特别是经历了对阵布赖顿的那场艰难失利以及之后19天没有比赛的日子。我们的反应、我们的踢法、我们的回归方式，你知道的，这太不可思议了。所以，对我们在每场比赛中展现出的表现感到高兴，当然，和往常一样，还有需要改进的地方，但我们只看积极的一面，现在正期待着周三的比赛。”

items.titleEn: Nottingham Forest 0-1 Arsenal: Premier League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: A late, deflected winner from Noni Madueke gave Arsenal a vital win in a low-quality game, Forest then missing two good chances to equaliseForest will want – and probably need – to make this game a mess. If it’s open and played through midfield, Arsenal will open them up because, with the guile they’ve added by buying Guimaraes, along with an in-form Odegaard, they have the ability to exploit space. For that reason, Forest need bodies everywhere, especially in the middle of the pitch, forcing them wide, where Saka might just’ve lost the spring in his acceleration following last season’s achilles injury while, on the other side, Eze isn’t going to go on the outside.Elsewhere, 10-man Sunderland trail Bournemouth 2-0 with seconds remaining, while Brighton have splattered Palace 5-0 to move second above Arsenal, their goal difference +18. Ridiculous behaviour. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Aha, David Hytner’s match report is here.
Which means that’s it from me. Thanks for your company and comments; peace out.

That was a huge win for Arsenal, who won’t have wanted to fall further behind City. They won’t get away with playing like that every week – Madueke’s deflected winner was their first shot on target – but they won’t. Arteta does, though, need to find a better attacking balance, and trying Eze against a low block makes some kind of sense, but I’m afraid it looks like it won’t work for him at Arsenal.
Also going on:
“Fresh” in that it wasn’t quite smelly enough to be off, but it really wasn’t far away.
Madueke thanks his lord and saviour Jesus Christ, to whom goes the glory, then praises Arsenal’s determination, saying they’ve struggled at Forest the last few season.

With the goal, he felt he’d beaten his man on the outside a few times so decided to go inside and thank God it went in, then it’s more praise for God and off he goes, collecting his player of the match award and smiling broadly.
It took a spawny winner, but Arsenal showed why they’re champions. Forest made poor decisions at crucial moments, but defended well.
90+4 min The corner comes in, the whistle goes for an infringement of some sort, and that’ll be it.

90+3 min More Murillo! He sends a terrific pass in behind, inside-left channel, and Delap is on to it, Timber in pursuit. Into the box he barrels, and he’s got to shoot, but he takes one more touch that allows the defender to slide in and block behind. If he goes earlier, he’s a little further out, but that doesn’t happen.

90+2 min Oh my days! Out on the left, Murillo espies opportunity, suddenly banging the ball between Konsa and Timber and exploding on to it, flying into the box. Rice looks to show him outside so he leans that way then Brazilians studs over the ball inside! The shot is on, he tries a curler … and it zooms just over the angle.
90 min We’ll have three additional minutes.

89 min With Forest boxed, Arsenal go down the left, Madueke’s cross overrun by Calfiori. But then Forest counter and, when Delap wins a throw, he takes it instantly, sending Hudson-Odoi away! With Wood in the middle, this is the chance! So Hudson-Odoi draws his man then squares, but his mate’s first touch takes him into traffic, he makes it worse by continuing in that direction, and his shot is blocked at source. Excellent play until the crucial moment, then every action and decision was the wrong one.

88 min Arsenal have played well since scoring, managing the game by keeping the ball inside the Forest half. They win a free-kick which Rice swings into the box, Murillo heading out; the throw goes short, and the ball is kept.

86 min I guess Hudson-Odoi is a victim of Glasner’s preferred formation, but he’s too good to be sat at the side for 85 minutes. I wonder if he might be able to do something as one of the 10s, because he’s a much better footballer than Ndoye and McAtee, and might dovetail well with Gibbs-White in that role.
85 min Two changes for Forest, Hudson-Odoi and Wood on for Cunha and McAtee.
84 min Arsenal disappear time, slowing down the play – something which felt impossible given the treacley nature of what we’ve been watching. Forest need to get in among them.
82 min Can Forest shift mindset to respond? They’re going to bring on Chris Wood when there’s a break in play, but Arsenal are expert in navigating a rearguard.

That kind of goal! Madueke picks up the ball a little further inside, rather than on the touchline he’s been sitting on. He runs at Munoz, twisting him up to create a shooting angle, lacing one hard that Sels should fish out at the near post, except a deflection off Cunha takes it past him near the far. When your champions, these are the things that go for you.
79 min More Arsenal crosses, more Forest clearances. I don’t think I understand what kind of goal Arteta wants his men to score, beyond a header or from a scramble.

78 min Forest sit back and Arsenal move the ball from side to side, but with no zip. Then, when Madeueke’s cross is deflected, Murillo heads clear, before Saka’s cross from way out is collected by Sels.
76 min …which Odegaard swings into the nearest forehead. This is desperately poor stuff.

75 min That Rice chance was the best Arsenal have created all match and they might yet nick it, but I can’t help but feel the changes made have lacked a little bit imagination, as Wenger might say, As things stand, they’ve yet top have a shot on target, something they’ve not managed across a 90 in five years. They do, though, have a free-kick out on the right…
74 min Changes for Forest, Kalimuendo and Sangare for Ndoye and Dominguez.

72 min Suddenly Arsenal inject pace, Saka drawing two men then passing between them for Odegaard, who turns first-time into space for Timber – the kind of triangulation that opens tight defences. Timber cuts back well too, Rice having arrived into the box, but his swept finish is too high.

69 min Schlager to Delap, who collects well and bulldozes between the Arsenal centre-backs. But mistrustful of his pace, he doesn’t sticks the ball through the gap and charge after it, instead shooting from 20 yards, the kind of effort that needs to be special to go in … which it isn’t and doesn’t.
68 min Timber’s first, er, action is to concede a corner, Raya coming for the corner and collecting well.

67 min On those changes, I like Timber and Merino, but I’d have gone for Lewis-Skelly as well; the players who’ve come on make it seem like Arsenal are just hoping for a ball into the box to work out well.
66 min Before the corner, a triple change for Arsenal: Timber, Merino and Gyokeres for White, Guimaraes and Havert, then the corner comes in and Gabriel heads high over the bar.

65 min Now Arsenal attack, Madueke again keeping the width and winning a corner. I’m not surprised Merino is stripping off, because he might at least threaten from set-pieces. Meantime, McAtee panics when the ball looks to be dropping for Odegaard just outside the box, hitchkicking behind from 20 yards out.

63 min Murillo releases Ndoye, who doesn’t quite have the pace to get rid of Gabriel. But he is ahead of him with runners, opting to check inside, which allows the defender to get back properly, blocking the shot at source.

62 min Sels comes and punches the corner clear, then Odegaard’s pass in behind is too strong for Calafiori. I wonder if Arteta might try Dowman, because he needs a bit of something different; I’d go Lews-Skelly for Rice or Guimaraes, because he has the ability the commit men in the middle of the pitch, beating them with skill or bouncing them with power.
61 min Calafiori finds Madueke, whose low cross is deflected behind. This time, as it’s from the left, Rice will take the corner.
60 min Raya comes for the corner and collects well, setting away a counter moved on by a lovely Saka touch. For all the good it does anyone, Madueke swiftly ceding possession.
59 min McAtee’s ball bounces through the box and eventually goes behind on the other side; Forest are building a bit of territorial pressure.

58 min Williams collects a loose ball and slides square, but Guimaraes gets the ahead of Dominguez, then Munoz wins a corner down the right. Forest have been the better team so far this half, little though that’s saying.

56 min This game and Leeds v Man United have been proper 80s fare, bodies everywhere and very little quality or composure. The physicality is a little different – violence is harder to perpetrate but compensated for with athleticism – and the result is a mess. I’d expect to see many more games like this, especially as, despite the money available, the very best attackers tend not to play in England.
55 min …which Munoz clears at the near post, then there’s a quick VAR check for handball, nothing doing.
54 min Immediately, Saka bounces down the other end and wins a corner for Arsenal…
53 min Cunha lanks through midfield and finds “Delap!” But no joy for Drury, his shot deflected behind for a corner which comes to nothing.
53 min Madueke weaves in off the left, shoots … directly into the nearest shins then, when Dominguez turns White, he runs through him and is booked.
51 min This game has been almost entirely devoid of quality; in that regard, it might be the worst I’ve seen this season.
50 min Forest have started the second half well and Delap outmuscles Gabriel on the right, then belts a cross to no one.

items.titleZh: 诺丁汉森林 0-1 阿森纳：英超联赛实况
items.summaryZh: 马杜埃凯终场前的折射绝杀助阿森纳艰难取胜，森林错失良机。
bodyZh: 大卫·海特纳的比赛报告来了。
这意味着我的播报到此结束。感谢大家的陪伴与评论，再见。
对阿森纳来说这是一场巨大的胜利，他们肯定不想进一步落后于曼城。他们不可能每场比赛都靠这种表现过关——马杜埃凯的折射绝杀是他们全场唯一一次射正——但他们确实赢了。不过，阿尔特塔确实需要找到更好的进攻平衡，尝试让埃泽面对低位防守在某种程度上说得通，但我恐这在阿森纳对他是行不通的。
同时进行的其他比赛：
“新鲜”的意思是它还没臭到不能要的地步，但也差不远了。
马杜埃凯感谢了他的救世主耶稣基督，荣耀归于主，随后赞扬了阿森纳的决心，称他们在过去几个赛季在森林的主场举步维艰。
关于这个进球，他觉得自己几次在外线过掉了防守球员，所以决定内切，感谢上帝球进了。接着他继续赞美上帝并走开，脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容，领取了全场最佳球员奖。
虽然赢得很侥幸，但阿森纳展现了他们为何是冠军。森林在关键时刻做出了糟糕的决定，但防守得很好。
90+4分钟 角球开出，裁判吹响了某个犯规的哨声，比赛就此结束。
90+3分钟 穆里略再次送出妙传！他送出一记精彩的左肋身后球，德拉普插上，廷贝尔在身后紧追不舍。他冲入禁区必须射门，但他多带了一下，让防守球员得以滑铲封堵出底线。如果他早点射门，距离可能会稍远一些，但并没有发生。
90+2分钟 我的天哪！穆里略在左路敏锐地发现机会，突然从孔萨和廷贝尔之间将球打过并爆量前插，飞速杀入禁区。赖斯试图引导他往外走，于是他顺势往那边一晃，随即将球扣向内侧！可以射门了，他尝试了一脚弧线球……结果稍稍高出横梁。
90分钟 我们将有三分钟的补时。
89分钟 森林被围困，阿森纳打到左路，马杜埃凯的传中被卡拉菲奥里超出底线。但随后森林反击，当德拉普赢得界外球时，他迅速主罚，将奥多伊放走！中路有伍德，这是个机会！于是奥多伊吸引了防守球员后回敲，但他的队友停球直接陷入重围，随后继续往那个方向带让情况变得更糟，射门在源头被封堵。除了关键时刻外表现极佳，但随后的每一个动作和决定都是错的。
88分钟 阿森纳进球后踢得不错，通过将球控制在森林半场来掌控比赛。他们赢得任意球，赖斯将球开进禁区，穆里略头球解围；随后开出短传，球被控制住。
86分钟 我猜奥多伊是格拉斯纳偏爱阵型的受害者，但他实力太强，不应该在场边枯坐85分钟。我想他或许可以胜任其中一个10号位，因为他比恩多耶和麦卡蒂是更好的足球运动员，并且在这个位置上能与吉布斯-怀特很好地搭档。
85分钟 森林做出两次换人，奥多伊和伍德换下库尼亚和麦卡蒂。
84分钟 阿森纳在消磨时间，放慢比赛节奏——考虑到我们一直在看的这种黏糊糊的比赛节奏，这原本让人觉得不可能。森林需要切入他们当中。
82分钟 森林能否转变心态做出回应？比赛暂停时他们将换上克里斯·伍德，但阿森纳是应对后防围剿的专家。
就是那样的进球！马杜埃凯在更靠内侧的位置拿球，而不是他一直呆的边线附近。他带球冲向穆尼奥斯，将其晃开并创造出射门角度，大力抽射，塞尔斯本该在近门柱将球扑出，奈尔库尼亚的折射让球从远门柱附近飞入网窝。当你成为冠军时，这些运势都会倾向你。
79分钟 更多的阿森纳传中，更多的森林解围。除了头球或混战，我实在看不懂阿尔特塔到底想让他的队员打进什么样的球。
78分钟 森林回收防线，阿森纳左右调度皮球，但毫无活力。随后，当马杜埃凯的传中被折射后，穆里略头球解围，萨卡的远距离传中被塞尔斯没收。
76分钟 ……厄德高将任意球罚向最近的额头。这表现简直糟糕透顶。
75分钟 赖斯的那次机会是阿森纳全场创造的最佳机会，他们或许还能偷走一场胜利，但我忍不住觉得换人缺乏一点想象力，正如温格所说。就目前而言，他们还没有一次射正，这是他们五年内首次在90分钟内未能做到这一点。不过他们在右路获得了一个任意球……
74分钟 森林换人，卡利穆恩多和桑加雷换下恩多耶和多明格斯。
72分钟 阿森纳突然提速，萨卡吸引两人防守后穿裆过人传给厄德高，后者顺势将球传给空当处的廷贝尔——正是这种三角配合撕开了密防。廷贝尔倒三角回传也很到位，赖斯插上禁区，但他的推射打高了。
69分钟施拉格传给德拉普，后者停球出色并在阿森纳中卫之间强行蛮横突破。但他对自己的速度缺乏信心，没有把球趟过空当追赶，而是在20码外直接起脚远射，这种射门需要极其精彩才能进……而这球显然不是，也没进。
68分钟 廷贝尔的第一个动作是送出一个角球，拉亚出击将角球稳稳没收。
67分钟 谈到那些换人，我喜欢廷贝尔和梅里诺，但我也会选择刘易斯-斯凯利；换上这些球员似乎让阿森纳只是指望把球吊进禁区能产生好结果。
66分钟 角球开出前，阿森纳做出三人换人调整：廷贝尔、梅里诺和哲凯赖什换下怀特、吉马良斯和哈弗茨，随后角球开出，加布里埃尔头球高出横梁。
65分钟 阿森纳现在发起进攻，马杜埃凯再次拉开宽度并赢得角球。梅里诺在脱训练服我并不意外，因为他至少能在定位球上制造威胁。与此同时，当皮球似乎要落在禁区外的厄德高脚下时，麦卡蒂感到惊慌，在20码外将球解围。
63分钟 穆里略传给恩多耶，但他的速度稍欠未能彻底甩开加布里埃尔。不过他跑在了前面并有队友接应，他选择往内切，这让防守球员得以从容回防并在源头封堵了射门。
62分钟塞尔斯出击双拳将角球击出，随后厄德高给卡拉菲奥里的直塞力量太大。我想阿尔特塔或许可以尝试一下多曼，因为他需要一点不同的东西；我会用刘易斯-斯凯利换下赖斯或吉马良斯，因为他具备在中路盘过防守球员的能力，既能用技巧也能用力量对抗。
61分钟 卡拉菲奥里找到马杜埃凯，后者的低平球传中被折射出底线。这一次由于是从左路发出，赖斯将主罚角球。
60分钟 拉亚出击摘下角球并稳稳没收，随后通过萨卡的一次精妙触球策动反击。然而这对所有人并没有什么用，马杜埃凯迅速丢掉了球权。
59分钟 麦卡蒂的传球在禁区内弹地而过，最终从另一侧滚出底线；森林正在建立一些区域压迫。
58分钟 威廉姆斯拿到松散的球并横敲，但吉马良斯抢在多明格斯之前解围，随后穆尼奥斯在右路赢得角球。
56分钟 这场比赛和利兹联对阵曼联的比赛颇有80年代的风格，场上到处都是身体对抗，却几乎没有技术含量和冷静。身体对抗的形式略有不同——暴力行为更难实施，但用运动能力弥补了——结果就是一团糟。我预计未来会有更多这样的比赛，尤其是尽管有资金支持，但最顶级的攻击手往往并不在英格兰踢球。
55分钟 ……穆尼奥斯在近门柱解围，随后进行了简短的手球VAR检查，没有点球。
54分钟 萨卡立刻在另一端发起冲击，为阿森纳赢得一个角球……
53分钟 库尼亚穿过中场并找到了“德拉普！”但未能如愿，他的射门被折射出底线送出角球，但角球毫无威胁。
53分钟 马杜埃凯从左路内切盘带，起脚射门……直接闷在最近的小腿上。随后多明格斯转身过掉怀特时被怀特从身后撞倒，怀特被黄牌警告。
51分钟 这场比赛几乎完全缺乏技术含量；从这个角度来看，这可能是本赛季我看过最糟糕的一场。
50分钟 森林下半场开局不错，德拉普在右路靠身体力压加布里埃尔，随后强力传中却没有找到任何人。

bodyEn: The theme before kick-off was blanks. Or, more precisely, whether either team could stop firing them at the City Ground. It was a detail to make Oliver Glasner extremely uncomfortable that his Nottingham Forest team had still to score at their own stadium this season. Arsenal, meanwhile, had drawn 0-0 on their previous two visits to this part of the east Midlands. They had only one win in five here.

Forest’s frustrations under their new manager go on. It was another spirited performance from them, bits to like, especially a full-throttle performance from Liam Delap in the No 9 position. But, for the fifth time under Glasner, there was not a goal to celebrate in front of the home support.

It was a game that came to feel increasingly set up for the famous terrace chant. One-nil to the Ars-en-nal. Or, as the travelling hordes would have it, one-nil to the champions. Arsenal did not play well. They created little, finishing with just one shot on target. How Noni Madueke made it count.

On as a half-time substitute, the winger took a pass from Declan Rice in the 80th minute and had only one thing on his mind. To cut inside from the left and unload. The connection was pure and that was when he caught a break, which he has worked to earn after a difficult start to the season. The ball deflected off Jair Cunha and flew past the Forest goalkeeper, Matz Sels.

Forest refused to accept the inevitable. Chris Wood, on as a substitute, delayed too long and saw Rice block. Murillo, of all players, danced inside from the left and curled off target. Delap was denied at the death by a thunderous Ezri Konsa block tackle. But it did feel inevitable. Forest, who missed the injured Morgan Gibbs-White, might have played all night and not scored. Arsenal had not forgotten their previous away fixture – the 3-0 defeat at Brighton. It remains the only blot on their season.

Arsenal had kicked off six points behind Manchester City, who have been perfect on the field in the league this season. Will it matter when the sanctions for their rule breaches are meted out? All Arsenal can do is play the situation as it stands and this was an occasion when the result was everything.

Mikel Arteta’s team dominated the ball. As they were always likely to do. They were determined to be patient. And yet they were flat and predictable until the closing stages. The lack of incisive movement was glaring. That said, Forest were compact out of possession in a 5-4-1 formation and hard to break down. They were resolved not to give up any easy yards.

Arsenal played their patterns. They tried to suck the life out of the home crowd, working on the principle that it is difficult for fans to get animated if their team do not have the ball. The first half drifted by in a lazy Sunday afternoon haze, no shots on target for either side.

Delap carried the physical fight; the Forest centre-forward was a willing and direct runner and he won a free-kick off Rice just outside the Arsenal box on 44 minutes. Neco Williams thumped it at Bruno Guimarães, who went down and stayed down. The Forest support were unhappy at what they perceived as Arsenal’s use of the dark arts. “Are you City in disguise?” they chanted.

Could a set piece provide the breakthrough? It felt the likeliest route. Murillo headed wide from a Forest corner in the 20th minute and was bloodied into the bargain; there was a whistle for a foul in the mass of bodies inside the six-yard box. At the other end, Kai Havertz headed over from a Rice free-kick on 37 minutes. He had a good look at the ball and was well-placed. It was a decent chance.

Arsenal have been a little barren in the first half this season. This was the seventh time in 10 matches since the Community Shield that they had failed to score in one. It has not been a problem. They needed to raise their levels for the second half.

Arteta’s first change was Madueke for Eberechi Eze on the left wing; an admission that the latter had failed to exert an influence. There was also a triple substitution on 66 minutes, the manager sending on Jurriën Timber, Mikel Merino and Viktor Gyökeres for Ben White, Guimarães and Havertz. He needed to shake things up because nothing was happening for his team. It was Forest who pushed after the restart, with Delap continuing to put himself about. He asked questions of Gabriel Magalhães, albeit the Arsenal defender tended to have the answers.

The minutes ticked down, the contest narrowing to a fine point and we waited to see whether there could be a moment, one big chance. Martin Ødegaard almost provided it in the 72nd minute when he released Timber with a lovely pass up the inside right. When he pulled back, Rice lifted wastefully high.

Glasner’s decision to introduce Ibrahim Sangaré for Dan Ndoye shortly afterwards was telling. Sangaré’s mission was to bolster the Forest midfield and yet he was slow to react to a half-cleared ball. When Rice played the pass, Madueke took over.
“We showed a champion spirit,” Madueke said. “Maybe last season, this game might not have gone for us. We have the extra belief and mentality.”

items.titleZh: 马杜埃凯打破诺丁汉森林僵局，顽强阿森纳险胜取胜
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳客场艰难击败诺丁汉森林，马杜埃凯替补登场打入制胜球。
bodyZh: 比赛开始前的主题是“哑火”。更准确地说，是双方谁能打破在城市球场的进球荒。奥利弗·格拉斯纳不得不面对一个令他极其尴尬的细节：本赛季至今，他的诺丁汉森林队在自己的主场还未取得过进球。与此同时，阿森纳此前两次造访东米德尔兰德的这片区域都以0-0战平收场，他们在这里的过去五场比赛中只赢过一场。
森林在新帅带领下的沮丧情绪仍在继续。这又是他们斗志昂扬的一场比赛，有许多可取之处，尤其是利亚姆·德拉普在9号位上的全力发挥。然而，在格拉斯纳手下，他们在主场球迷面前已经是第五次没有进球可庆祝了。
这场比赛越来越让人觉得像是为那首著名的看台助威歌做好了准备。阿森纳一比零。或者，正如随队出征的球迷们所高唱的那样，卫冕冠军一比零。阿森纳踢得并不好。他们创造的机会寥寥无几，全场仅有一次射正。但马杜埃凯如何将它转化为进球。
作为中场替补登场，这名边锋在第80分钟接到了赖斯的传球，脑海中只有一个念头：从左路内切并起脚射门。这脚击球非常纯粹，他也运气不错，在经历了赛季初的艰难开局后，这是他通过努力赢得的回报。皮球击中雅尔·库尼亚发生折射，飞过了森林门将马茨·塞尔斯的十指关。
森林拒绝接受既定结局。替补登场的克里斯·伍德犹豫太久，眼睁睁看着赖斯完成封堵。穆里略更是从左路内切并兜射偏出。德拉普在终场前被埃兹里·孔萨雷霆万钧般的铲断化解了绝杀机会。但这确实让人觉得结局早已注定。缺少了受伤的摩根·吉布斯-怀特的森林，或许踢上一整夜也无法进球。阿森纳并没有忘记他们之前的客场比赛——客场0-3不敌布莱顿。那依然是他们本赛季唯一的污渍。
阿森纳开场时落后领头羊曼城六分，后者本赛季在联赛中表现完美。当针对他们违规行为的制裁出台时，这还重要吗？阿森纳所能做的就是按现状踢好每一场比赛，而这场比赛的结果就是一切。
米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队控制了球权，正如他们一贯所做的那样。他们决心保持耐心。然而直到比赛尾声，他们的表现依然沉闷且可预测。缺乏犀利的无球跑动是显而易见的。话虽如此，森林在无球状态下排出了严密的5-4-1阵型，极难被攻破。他们决心不轻易丢掉任何码数。
阿森纳打出了他们的战术套路。他们试图抽干主场球迷的热情，其原理是如果一支球队没有球权，球迷就很难兴奋起来。上半场在一个慵懒的周日午后雾气中缓缓流逝，双方均无射正。
德拉普承担了身体对抗的重任；森林中锋跑动积极且直接，他在第44分钟从赖斯脚下赢得了一个禁区外的任意球。内科·威廉姆斯将球重重轰向布鲁诺·吉马良斯，后者倒地不起。森林球迷对他们认为阿森纳在使用的“黑暗艺术”感到不满。“你们是曼城的替身吗？”他们高喊道。
定位球能打破僵局吗？这感觉是最有可能的途径。穆里略在第20分钟接森林角球头球顶偏，还因此头部挂彩；六码区内的人群中传出了犯规的哨声。在另一端，凯·哈弗茨在第37分钟接赖斯的任意球头球攻门顶高。他看准了球的位置，落点也很好。这是一个不错的机会。
